model: Independent Gaussian seed slopes with a fixed location shift; conditional on this dataset, not a population-power guarantee.
selection_rule: Smallest candidate budget whose lower 95% Monte Carlo Wilson bound for H2 detection reaches 0.80.
test: Two-sided scipy.stats.wilcoxon(method='auto'); positive median required for H2 detection. Family 7 uses conservative Bonferroni, not simulated Holm.
